findings.issue: `span_range_tensorPowerRep_eq_span_range_map_const` (line 69) and `toSubmodule_range_tensorPowerRep_asAlgebraHom_eq_span_range_map_const` (line 92) mention no symmetric-group object — only `tensorPowerRep`, `PiTensorProduct.map`, `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin` and `Representation.toSubmodule_range_asAlgebraHom` — yet they sit under `Symmetric/TensorAction/` in a file importing `SchurWeyl.lean` (Maschke + double centralizer). summary: Two purely general-linear lemmas about `tensorPowerRep` are placed in the symmetric-group directory although they contain no symmetric-group material and depend on nothing from `SchurWeyl.lean`; they belong with `tensorPowerRep` in `ClassicalGroups/TensorPower.lean`.
